notes: Rule 5: «سمعت أبا عبد الله» makes the Imam the last link
The long saying carries bracketed variant readings such as «(يحبنا)», «(علي عليه السلام)» and «(وفاطمة)» inside the matn; they are not links
«قال: وإذا حضر الكافر الوفاة» continues the same report with a second scene inside the matn; no second isnad
